params.name: start_height
params.description: The block height of the events being streamed. Either provide this parameter or `start_block_id` parameter. This parameter is incompatible with `start_block_id` parameter.

params.name: start_block_id
params.description: The block id of the events being streamed. Either provide this parameter or `start_height` parameter. This parameter is incompatible with `start_height` parameter.

params.name: heartbeat_interval
params.description: Interval in block heights at which the server should return a heartbeat message to the client.

params.name: event_types
params.description: A comma-separated list of events type to include.

params.name: addresses
params.description: A comma-separated list of addresses who's events should be included.

params.name: contracts
params.description: A comma-separated list of contracts who's events should be included.

items.docs:
IMPORTANT NOTE: This is a WebSocket connection, so the `ws://` or `wss://` schema should be used to subscribe to this endpoint.

This endpoint streams on-chain events for all blocks starting at the requested start block, up until the latest available block. Once the latest block is reached, the stream will remain open, and responses will be sent for each new block as it becomes available.
